Preference.app:summary: To start a chat, tap the chat button at the bottom right of the Chats tab and choose a device. The device must have Bluechat open and be within about 15 meters of you. For the best results, pick from the Active or Available devices in the list. Bluechat connects automatically, and once connected you are taken straight to the chat screen. The other device is told that you have connected.

Preference.app:title: Sending files
Preference.app:summary:
In a chat you can send photos, audio and videos to the connected device.
To capture one, tap the camera icon next to the message box, choose Take a photo or Record a video, and Bluechat opens your camera app. When you are done, the file is sent automatically.
To send an existing file, tap the folder icon next to the message box, choose Photo, Video or Audio, and pick the file. It is sent automatically.
Note: the chat buttons only work while the other device is active.

Preference.app:title: Voice notes
Preference.app:summary: Press and hold the mic button to record, then release to send.\nSlide left while holding to cancel. Slide up to lock the recording so you can let go; then tap the send arrow to send it, or the bin to discard it.\nNote: you can only record a voice note while the message box is empty.

To make a call, open the Calls tab, tap the call button at the bottom right and choose a device. If the device is not connected yet, Bluechat connects first and then starts the call.\nNote: you can leave the call screen and keep using Bluechat while the call continues.

Preference.app:title: Video calling
Preference.app:summary: To make a video call, open the Video Calls tab, tap the video button at the bottom right and choose a device. If the device is not connected yet, Bluechat connects first and then starts the call.\nNote: unlike voice calls, a video call ends if you leave the video call screen. Bluetooth video is demanding and should not run in the background.

Preference.app:title: Profile photo
Preference.app:summary: Tap your photo at the top left of the main screen to open your profile. Tap the camera button on the photo to take a new picture or choose one from your files.\nNote: any device that connects to you automatically receives your photo.

To block a device, touch and hold it in the device list, choose Block and confirm. A blocked device can no longer chat with you, call you or video call you.\nNote: blocking does not stop a device from finding or connecting to you.
